families.hypothesis: Completed-bar directional persistence may survive costs in selected horizons.
families.falsification: Net walk-forward performance is not positive and stable against fixed benchmarks.
families.paper_gate: Pre-register horizon and signal; execute no earlier than the next tradable observation.

families.hypothesis: Time-series or cross-sectional persistence may exist but can crash and decay.
families.falsification: The effect disappears out of sample or after costs and crash-window stress.
families.paper_gate: Freeze ranking universe, rebalance rule, lag and delisting treatment.

families.hypothesis: Rate, funding or basis compensation may persist while embedding tail and funding-liquidity risk.
families.falsification: Net carry is not robust to funding sign reversal, borrow and liquidation stress.
families.paper_gate: Use exact product funding timestamps and mark-price liquidation rules.

families.hypothesis: Predefined valuation proxies may explain cross-sectional returns but require defensible economic meaning.
families.falsification: The fixed proxy lacks stable out-of-sample rank information after neutralization and costs.
families.paper_gate: Define publication lag, availability time and missing-data policy before testing.

families.hypothesis: Temporary deviations from a preregistered equilibrium may revert before costs and structural breaks dominate.
families.falsification: Stationarity and convergence fail in held-out windows or losses accelerate under breaks.
families.paper_gate: Estimate equilibrium only on past data and cap exposure without martingale sizing.

families.hypothesis: Observed price gaps may exceed all synchronized execution and transfer constraints.
families.falsification: No positive locked spread remains under simultaneous executable prices and failure costs.
families.paper_gate: Simulate both legs, queue position, transfer unavailability and venue-specific collateral.

families.hypothesis: Two-sided quoting may earn spread only when inventory and adverse-selection losses are controlled.
families.falsification: Realistic fills and inventory liquidation produce non-positive net PnL or unsafe tails.
families.paper_gate: Use order-book replay; never assume every touched quote fills.

families.hypothesis: Conditional volatility may be forecastable without implying direction or option profitability.
families.falsification: Forecasts fail proper scoring and economic tests in held-out stress regimes.
families.paper_gate: Separate forecast accuracy from tradable option or variance-strategy returns.

families.hypothesis: Predefined events may shift returns or volatility after timestamp and selection controls.
families.falsification: Abnormal outcomes vanish with clean timestamps, controls and multiple-event correction.
families.paper_gate: Store announcement availability time and prohibit revised data in the event window.

families.hypothesis: Fixed cross-sectional ranks may predict relative outcomes across a survivorship-safe universe.
families.falsification: Rank spreads fail after listing history, liquidity, costs and multiple testing are controlled.
families.paper_gate: Freeze point-in-time universe eligibility and capacity floors.

families.hypothesis: Finalized, economically interpretable chain data may add information after publication delays.
families.falsification: Signals disappear using finalized point-in-time data and revision-aware validation.
families.paper_gate: Record block finality, ingestion time, vendor version and label provenance.

families.hypothesis: Funding and futures basis may compensate constrained capital but are not guaranteed yield.
families.falsification: Net hedged carry fails under observed funding changes, borrow and liquidation stress.
families.paper_gate: Bybit is primary; bind exact contract type, timestamps, funding and mark-price rules.

families.hypothesis: Predefined statistical relations may persist out of sample after dependence and search corrections.
families.falsification: Performance fails untouched data, multiplicity control or structural-break stress.
families.paper_gate: Log every candidate, parameter and dataset inspected.

families.hypothesis: ML may improve bounded forecasts only under leakage-free temporal validation and independent challenge.
families.falsification: The model fails nested temporal evaluation, calibration, drift and cost-aware benchmarks.
families.paper_gate: Freeze features, preprocessing, search budget and untouched final test data.

families.hypothesis: Sizing and risk overlays may reduce losses without converting a weak strategy into evidence of edge.
families.falsification: The overlay worsens tail loss, turnover or recovery under independent stress scenarios.
families.paper_gate: Report unscaled and scaled results; enforce deterministic exposure and loss limits.
